source.reference: Simulate part mitsubishi-kasei-15 (parts/engines/mitsubishi-kasei-15/engine.json): Navy manual / TAIC ratings

metadata.source: Navy engine manual (Jan 1941) and TAIC Manual No. 1; see the part's engine.json
metadata.approximation: Two-speed supercharger approximated by its second-speed rating held flat to 6000 m (1400 hp in first speed at 2600 m is not representable). BSFC is the JSBSim model's auto-rich value at rated power, used for every mode; not sourced. Dry mass: dry mass not found; the Kasei 11's 725 kg is assumed.
